title: Empty Press Lectern
purpose: Announcement and communication surfaces; statement moments.
story: An empty press lectern alone in a grand hall — the unoccupied podium of public address, the words not yet spoken.
environment: A formal briefing hall, a single lectern on a low dais before draped panelling, the room beyond dim and empty.
architecture: State-room interior — a panelled backdrop, a shallow stepped dais, pilasters receding into shadow.
composition: The lone lectern off-centre under a falling warm light, the draped backdrop filling the frame, deep negative space to either side.
objects: a brass lamp on the lectern
negativeExtra: a seal or crest with text
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade with one warm source and brass-on-black palette consistent with scene-01; the lectern bears no markings.
